verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's Inference Providers documents image and video generation, including LoRA and style customization, alongside chat completion. It exposes these through a single, consistent API across providers, so a developer can call non-text models on the same platform. missing for 10: explicit documentation of vision (image-understanding) and audio (speech/ASR/TTS) tasks, detailed task-level API docs for image generation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: **Image and Video Generation**: Create custom images and videos, including support for LoRAs and style customization
Our platform integrates with leading AI infrastructure providers, giving you access to their specialized capabilities through a single, consistent API.
